description: Database migration script using Alembic and SQLAlchemy to create and manage main database tables for a project, including users, articles, tags, followers, favorites, and commentaries, with associated triggers and constraints.

methods.name: create_updated_at_trigger
methods.description: Creates a PostgreSQL trigger function to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp column.

methods.name: timestamps
methods.description: Returns SQLAlchemy timestamp columns for 'created_at' and 'updated_at' with default values and update behavior.

methods.name: create_users_table
methods.description: Creates the 'users' table with fields for id, username, email, salt, hashed_password, bio, image, and timestamp columns, and sets up a trigger for modification time updates.

methods.name: create_followers_to_followings_table
methods.description: Creates a join table for user followers and followings with composite primary key.

methods.name: create_articles_table
methods.description: Creates the 'articles' table with fields for id, slug, title, description, body, author_id, and timestamp columns, with a trigger for modification time updates.

methods.name: create_tags_table
methods.description: Creates the 'tags' table with a primary key 'tag'.

methods.name: create_articles_to_tags_table
methods.description: Creates a join table linking articles and tags with composite primary key.

methods.name: create_favorites_table
methods.description: Creates a 'favorites' table linking users and articles with composite primary key.

methods.name: create_commentaries_table
methods.description: Creates a 'commentaries' table with fields for id, body, author_id, article_id, timestamps, and a trigger for modification time updates.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Executes functions to create all tables and triggers in the migration.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops all created tables and functions to revert the migration.
